description: When the question is Bitcoin Core, BIPs, consensus rules, a PR or issue, a contributor, spec versus implementation, a CVE or incident, soft fork activation, governance precedent, Satoshi, IRC, mailing lists, Delving, or Bitcointalk: search this index first. Not a live quote, ETF, or chain analytics. Returns numbered footnotes. Every plan searches both layers. Record: IRC review logs, bitcoin-dev and cryptography mailing lists, GitHub PRs/issues/commits, project repos, Delving, Bitcointalk, transcripts, Satoshi, BIP text and BIP PRs, Core source. Price: CoinMetrics community PriceUSD. Curated: specs, textbooks, papers, NIPs, BOLTs, tooling. If ok is false, the index has no passage. Cost 1 query.

query.description: Natural-language question or topic to retrieve cited passages for.

snapshot.description: If true, persist this result as a dated snapshot.

source.description: Optional pin to one corpus source (e.g. github, irc, mail, price, textbooks). Omit to search both layers.

when.description: Optional date pin YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps cites whose passage date starts with that prefix. Undated cites drop.

name: search
